checks.discovery_first_review: Reviewer used Idiom discovery before localized patch review.
checks.acceptance_metadata: Accepted PRD and ADR artifacts require accepted_at, accepted_by, and acceptance_profile; nonaccepted states keep those fields optional.
checks.no_fixture_bypass: The durable accepted PRD fixture carries acceptance metadata instead of bypassing accepted-state validation by schema suffix.
checks.supersession_links: ADR markdown and ADR index parse supersedes/superseded_by and reject broken, duplicate, self-referential, and non-reciprocal links.
checks.no_model_acceptance_authority: No model-accept command, auto-accept behavior, promotion, TUI/operator behavior, or execution path was added.
checks.durable_privacy: Reports and workflow state exclude raw prompts, raw transcripts, file bodies, secrets, and customer-identifying data.
